title: Mi Band 4 + xdrip - bolus data incomplete (lack of space on Mi Band screen, unnecessary data to be removed)
symptom: The bolus data shown on Mi Band 4 is incomplete (cut) because the line is too short and there is too much data to be shown. The missing 'u' data is pointed by left arrow, and unnecessary data containing 'at' is pointed by right arrow.
cause: The problem is that the line on Mi Band is too short and there is too much data to be shown, including unnecessary 'at' text.
fix: The suggested solution is to remove the part of the info containing 'at' from the display. A patch was released by the developer of a fork on his Patreon site.
evidence_quote: In my opinion the very simple solution to this problem is to remove the part of the info containing "at" pointed by right arrow.
